name: Tosatsu no Sono
source:
Somewhere in the world there is a place where soldiers tune up their skills - it gets called Slaughterhouse. A group of society cast-offs including futanari and transvestites live here. This is a hymn and requiem dedicated to them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-april-2007-zwei-worter.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
世界某处有个让士兵磨炼本领的地方，人们称之为“屠宰场”。包括扶她与异装者在内的一群社会弃民生活于此。这是一首献给他们的赞歌与安魂曲。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-april-2007-zwei-worter.html]vndbreview[/url]]
